intent: Owner requested more animation on Foundations. New page-only illustration motion augments the hand-off; the spring lane retains its 2400ms cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) timeline.

implementation.clock: One shared Reanimated frame callback; actual elapsed time; paused while the app is inactive and under live Reduced Motion; stopped on unmount
implementation.palette: Five staggered 6px lifts with 3.5% scale, 6s cycle
implementation.radius: Authored radius to square and back, 2.8s motion plus reading hold, 6s cycle
implementation.icons: Bell ringing, settings rotation, heart pulse and rocket lift, 6s cycles
implementation.type: Existing RevealGroup and brisk Reveal entrances
implementation.replay: Existing Reveal remount, with controlled Switch value retained and replay focus preserved

observations: Each run sampled a complete six-second illustration cycle, followed by 1200ms under live Reduced Motion.
All sampled spring rectangles remained within the measured lane throughout the cycle, including easing overshoot.
Keyboard Enter replay preserved the unchecked Switch value and replay button focus in all four runs.
No page overflow, page errors or console errors in any run.
Temporary Color, Shape, Motion and Icon card captures were visually inspected at desktop, tablet and phone sizes. No screenshots are retained in Git.
